scope: BTC/USD and ETH/USD cash-funded long-or-cash systems; 8 predeclared candidate applications, not 8 original mathematical inventions or a 10000-system search.
selection: One new candidate per asset selected solely on 2025H1 maximum worst-scenario(net minus 0.5 daily-close drawdown), lexical ties. Lock before this run evaluates later periods. All later candidates retained for audit, no reselection.
execution: Signal from completed daily i, finalized close+60s, fills at open i+2 or i+3. Buy cap uses latest finalized daily volume i-2 at execution i, including delay scenario. Adverse side-aware tick rounding; historical lot/minimum assumptions. Full OHLC fills and exits are screening proxies, not verified executable liquidity. Terminal sale pays all specified costs and never counts as a natural completed episode.

controls.buyHold: Each asset, same lag/start/fee-inclusive entry budget; retains idle cash
controls.eth40: Prior fixedSMA40 hysteresis/warmup90 same daily protocol
controls.btcWeeklySignal: Native 40-week SMA hysteresis1.0166, current-native-week-open availability cutoff evaluated at daily-close+60s, then same daily lag/entrybudget. Normalized signal control, not exact minute-execution/sizing/mark-cap parity with current $100000 BTC paper service.

bootstrap.interpretation: Descriptive paired bootstrap only. Known history reuse, unknown prior candidate search count and few episodes prevent confirmatory significance claims.

limitations: No untouched historical holdout: these dates were previously searched.
Eight candidate applications can share a mathematical or economic family; no parameter-grid inflation.
No model changes after ranking. Corrections require a disclosed separate run.
Returns exclude taxes, infrastructure costs and inaccessible executable depth.
Window runs reset to cash and force terminal sale; continuous run is diagnostic.
A strongest historical candidate is not a universal or proven future-profit system.
